name: OpenMausBot
author: milind-soni
description: Self-hosted Grokbot-style workspace: persistent AI bots, each with its own files and memory, driven from a browser. OpenMausBot's Node server serves its own web UI on loopback :8799 and is published tailnet-only over HTTPS on the same port. Browsers pair with a code (`openmausbot pair`); the owner API is never exposed beyond the tailnet. Engine CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, ...) are signed in separately as this box's user.
